name: DARE-bench
intro: DARE-bench 是一个面向数据科学与机器学习建模任务的基准，用于评估大模型在复杂多步数据科学任务中的建模能力与指令忠实度，并提供可验证真值以支持客观评测。
build_method: Kaggle衍生任务, 可验证真值
modality: 文本, 代码, 表格
task_type: 代码生成, 数据科学建模, 时间序列预测
eval_feature: 可验证真值, 指令遵循, 过程评估
intro_en: DARE-bench is a benchmark for data science and machine learning modeling tasks. It evaluates LLM agents on complex multi-step data science workflows, instruction fidelity, and objectively verifiable outcomes.
task_type_en: Code Generation, Data Science Modeling, Time Series Forecasting
eval_feature_en: Verifiable Ground Truth, Instruction Following, Process Evaluation
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["抓取 Kaggle 原始数据集"] --> B["按标签、许可证、规模和元数据做筛选"]
    B --> C["整理数据描述、表结构与文件信息"]
    C --> D["用 LLM 判断任务可行性、目标列与特征列"]
    D --> E["生成分类、回归和时间序列任务"]
    E --> F["拆分出 IF 与 MM / XF / CF 等任务版本"]
    F --> G["执行后处理：噪声注入、重采样、实体检查"]
    G --> H["在沙盒里运行参考流程验证任务可解"]
    H --> I["导出标准化训练集、评测集和验证工件"]
    I --> J["按 Accuracy、Macro-F1、Clipped R^2 做评测"]
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Crawl raw Kaggle datasets"] --> B["Filter them by tags, license, size, and metadata"]
    B --> C["Collect dataset descriptions, schema signals, and files"]
    C --> D["Use an LLM to infer feasibility, target columns, and feature columns"]
    D --> E["Create classification, regression, and time-series tasks"]
    E --> F["Split them into IF and MM / XF / CF variants"]
    F --> G["Apply post-processing such as noise injection, resampling, and entity checks"]
    G --> H["Run reference solutions in a sandbox to verify solvability"]
    H --> I["Export standardized train sets, eval sets, and verification artifacts"]
    I --> J["Score models with Accuracy, Macro-F1, and Clipped R^2"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2602.24288. The paper defines DARE-bench as 6,300 Kaggle-derived data science tasks with verifiable ground truth. Its construction Figure 2 has four stages: Dataset Sourcing filters Kaggle candidates by tags, license, size, and metadata; Task Design uses an LLM to analyze schema summaries, targets, features, feasibility, and task formulation; Post-Process applies splits, instruction-following noise injection, resampling, or entity checks for time-series tasks; Finalization validates solvability in a sandbox and emits standardized benchmark artifacts. The benchmark supports instruction-following and ML modeling variants across classification, regression, and time-series forecasting, with objective scoring against generated files or predictive ground truth.
